# RouteSetupPanel

Hosted route setup content with a named heading, explicit cancellation and a Continue action gated by host-validated readiness.

- **Import:** `import { RouteSetupPanel } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Map
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; not linked to Figma yet.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/map-routesetuppanel--docs>

## Example

From its `Locations` story.

```tsx
import React from "react";
import {
  type ComboboxOption,
  RouteLocationField,
  RouteSetupPanel,
  ThemeProvider,
} from "@kozmos-ds/react";

const lobby = {
  value: "lobby",
  label: "North terminal lobby",
  description: "North Terminal · Ground floor",
};

const gallery = {
  value: "gallery",
  label: "Gallery",
  description: "North Terminal · Level 2",
};

export function RouteSetupPanelExample() {
  const [origin, setOrigin] = React.useState<ComboboxOption | null>(lobby);
  const [destination, setDestination] = React.useState<ComboboxOption | null>(
    gallery,
  );
  const [originQuery, setOriginQuery] = React.useState("");
  const [destinationQuery, setDestinationQuery] = React.useState("");
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <RouteSetupPanel
        onContinue={() => {}}
        onClose={() => {}}
        ready={!!origin && !!destination}
        description="Search for a place to choose your route points."
      >
        <RouteLocationField
          label="From"
          location={origin}
          query={originQuery}
          options={[lobby, gallery]}
          disabled={undefined}
          onQueryChange={setOriginQuery}
          onSelect={setOrigin}
          onClear={() => {
            setOrigin(null);
            setOriginQuery("");
          }}
          clearLabel="Clear origin"
        />
        <RouteLocationField
          label="To"
          location={destination}
          query={destinationQuery}
          options={[lobby, gallery]}
          disabled={undefined}
          onQueryChange={setDestinationQuery}
          onSelect={setDestination}
          onClear={() => {
            setDestination(null);
            setDestinationQuery("");
          }}
          clearLabel="Clear destination"
        />
      </RouteSetupPanel>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## RouteSetupPanel

Setup content for an existing sheet. Hosts resolved-place fields; never calculates routes or owns dismissal.

It forwards its ref to `HTMLElement`. Its props are `RouteSetupPanelProps`, which extends `React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>`.

- `ready`: `boolean`, **required**.

  Host has resolved and validated every required route point. Text alone is not readiness.

- `pending`: `boolean`, optional, default `false`.
- `title`: `string`, optional, default `"Set up a route"`.
- `description`: `string`, optional.
- `continueLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"Continue"`.
- `closeLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"Close route setup"`.
- `onContinue`: `() => void`, **required**.
- `onClose`: `() => void`, **required**.

  Remains available while pending; the host cancels requests and restores focus.

- `children`: `React.ReactNode`, **required**.
- `presentation`: `"hosted" | "standalone"`, optional, default `"hosted"`.
- `surface`: `SurfaceVariant`, optional, default `"solid"`.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## Types these props take

### SurfaceVariant

From `@kozmos-ds/react`.

```ts
/**
 * What a surface is made of. Solid — the background colour with the subtle
 * border — is the default everywhere; glass, the glass surface role composed
 * from `Semantics.Effect.glass`, is a choice a product makes per surface.
 */
type SurfaceVariant = "solid" | "glass";
```
